clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Gorbold Steelhand keeps trade moving along Darkshore’s coast. The dwarven merchant brings goods from far across the Great Sea for travelers, crafters, and night elves.

Gorbold Steelhand brings Ironforge trade to Auberdine. Night elves populate much of northern Kalimdor, so Alliance outposts depend on merchants who cross the Great Sea. Gorbold works alongside the kaldorei, selling trade goods, reagents, crafting supplies, and tools. Travelers come to him as they prepare to explore Darkshore’s dangerous shores and forests.

Gorbold Steelhand watches the perilous waters off Auberdine as closely as his stock. Reefs along Darkshore have swallowed Alliance vessels, and lost cargo draws the merchant’s interest. Travelers who dive into the deep ocean may find him eager to hear about salvage and lost logs from sunken wrecks.
